lead: TTS LAW FIRM - TIMOTIUS & PARTNERS (hereinafter as to “TTSLF”) was founded in 1997 by Dr. (Commerce) Timotius Tumbur Simbolon, SH., MH. - Advocate, National Receiver/Curator and Member of INSOL International - who built this practice from zero with tenacity and absolute devotion to the profession. Now handling both National and International legal practices.
paragraphs: Now, the strong foundation of the Founder is in his expertise, extensive experience, and unquestionable **“trusted and ability”** values of the highest order for clients. The Founder carries a vision and a legacy statement for national law and for a part of international law, both in practice and in profession. Therefore this Profile is not merely a Firm Profile, but an expression, soul, and deep thought on the essence of legal counsel, agreements, and disputes - from inception to resolution.

The Founder and Senior Partners hold Professor and Doctoral degrees, with comparative studies in advanced jurisdictions. They master legal theory and practice, are specialists in their fields, thinkers, providers of comprehensive solutions, trustworthy, responsible, and upholding the supremacy of law, legal certainty and justice. Supported by qualified and specialized personnel.

**OUR MISSION:** To be a leading Law Firm in Indonesia and an integral part in preparing national and international scale business agreements, including resolution of national, foreign, and multinational corporate disputes - a legacy to be continued by future generations. **PHILOSOPHY: With Law, Your Business Is Secured.**
This is not a slogan. It is a guarantee of legal protection that endures through all commercial transactions.

In 40 years of practice, when we compare the legal fees paid by clients with the results obtained, clients have gained profits hundreds, even thousands of times greater. This success is achieved because the Founder and Senior Partners work effectively to control with a cool hand, meticulously and wisely, managing and handling clients' legal interests.
This Firm collaborates with expert Advocates from other Law Firms in Indonesia and abroad as satellites - kindred in spirit and struggle.
